crossRefs.note: The sea is his, and he made it. His hands formed the dry land.
Yahweh, how many are your works! In wisdom, you have made them all. The earth is full of your riches.
“Or who shut up the sea with doors, when it broke out of the womb,

translations.web: These see Yahweh’s deeds, and his wonders in the deep.
translations.bsb: They saw the works of the LORD, and His wonders in the deep.
translations.kjv: These see the works of the LORD, and his wonders in the deep.
translations.asv: These see the works of Jehovah, And his wonders in the deep.
